build.memory_scope: managed DP NumPy buffers; excludes caller motion, input conversion, interpreter and Python object overhead
build.work_scope: preprocessing DP backups, not search-tree expansions; include build wall time in the shared budget
build.column_order: supplied motion ID order; compressed motion retains its original-ID mapping
build.pd_scope: independent terminal-survival optimum, not the min-J route

compression.signature: all absolute frames; exact cell IDs including frame 0 and special-bin labels
compression.grouping: fixed conservative full-column equivalence; not depth-adaptive
compression.floating_order: group aggregation may change rounding; original-ID replay remains required
